description: Source code for the Mattermost server API related to team management, including team creation, retrieval, update, deletion, member management, invite handling, and icon management.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Handles creation of a new team, including permission checks, license limits, and optional scheme role assignment.

methods.name: getTeam
methods.description: Retrieves a team by ID, with optional content reviewer mode and permission checks.

methods.name: getTeamByName
methods.description: Retrieves a team by its name, with permission validation.

methods.name: updateTeam
methods.description: Updates team details, with permission and change validation.

methods.name: patchTeam
methods.description: Partially updates team properties, handling group constraints and audit logging.

methods.name: restoreTeam
methods.description: Restores a soft-deleted team, checking license limits.

methods.name: updateTeamPrivacy
methods.description: Updates team privacy settings, including open invite status.

methods.name: regenerateTeamInviteId
methods.description: Regenerates the team's invite ID, with permission validation.

methods.name: deleteTeam
methods.description: Deletes a team, either soft or permanent, with permission checks.

methods.name: getTeamsForUser
methods.description: Fetches teams associated with a user, with permission validation.

methods.name: getTeamsUnreadForUser
methods.description: Retrieves unread team notifications for a user, with permission validation.

methods.name: getTeamMember
methods.description: Fetches a specific team member's details, with permission and visibility checks.

methods.name: getTeamMembers
methods.description: Lists members of a team with sorting and filtering options.

methods.name: getTeamMembersForUser
methods.description: Lists teams for a specific user, with permission validation.

methods.name: getTeamMembersByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple team members by their IDs, with permission validation.

methods.name: addTeamMember
methods.description: Adds a user to a team, with permission and group constraint validation.

methods.name: addUserToTeamFromInvite
methods.description: Adds a user to a team via invite token or ID.

methods.name: addTeamMembers
methods.description: Batch adds multiple users to a team, with validation and error reporting.

methods.name: removeTeamMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a team, with permission and group constraint validation.

methods.name: getTeamUnread
methods.description: Gets unread status for a team for a user.

methods.name: getTeamStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a team, with permission validation.

methods.name: updateTeamMemberRoles
methods.description: Updates roles for a team member, with permission validation.

methods.name: updateTeamMemberSchemeRoles
methods.description: Updates scheme roles for a team member.

methods.name: getAllTeams
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all teams with optional total count.

methods.name: searchTeams
methods.description: Searches teams based on criteria, with permission validation.

methods.name: teamExists
methods.description: Checks if a team exists by name, considering user permissions.

methods.name: importTeam
methods.description: Imports team data from a file, restricted to non-cloud licenses.

methods.name: inviteUsersToTeam
methods.description: Invites users via email to a team, with optional graceful handling and job scheduling.

methods.name: inviteGuestsToChannels
methods.description: Invites guest users to channels within a team, with license and permission checks.

methods.name: getInviteInfo
methods.description: Provides information about an invite token.

methods.name: invalidateAllEmailInvites
methods.description: Invalidates all email invites, with permission validation.

methods.name: getTeamIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the team's icon image, with permission and cache validation.

methods.name: setTeamIcon
methods.description: Sets a new icon for a team, with permission and size validation.

methods.name: removeTeamIcon
methods.description: Removes the team's icon, with permission validation.

methods.name: updateTeamScheme
methods.description: Updates the scheme associated with a team, with license and permission validation.

methods.name: teamMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Lists team members excluding group-constrained members, with permission validation.
